allow: PowerShell(foreach \($h in @\("https://workbit.it/","https://www.workbit.it/","https://app.workbit.it/"\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $h -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop -UseBasicParsing; "$h -> $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if \($resp\) { "$h -> $\([int]$resp.StatusCode\) Location=$\($resp.Headers['Location']\)" } else { "$h -> ERRORE: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://app.workbit.it/api/auth/webauthn/login/options" -Method Post -ContentType "application/json" -Body "{}" -ErrorAction Stop; "rpId = " + $r.options.rpId } catch { "ERRORE: " + $_.Exception.Message; if \($_.ErrorDetails\) { $_.ErrorDetails.Message } })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://app.workbit.it/logo.png" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; "logo.png -> $\($r.StatusCode\), $\($r.Headers['Content-Type']\), $\($r.RawContentLength\) byte" } catch { "logo.png -> ERRORE: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
